Action definitions and argument unions for command handling.

# Purpose
Defines the shared action interface used by the application command system. The `fdctl_args` union groups the argument fields for each supported command, such as `run1`, `monitor`, `watch`, `configure`, `set_identity`, `dev`, `backtest`, `keys`, `txn`, `dump`, `repair`, `load`, `quic_trace`, `snapshot_load`, `udpecho`, and `metrics`. The `fd_action` structure describes one command entry with its name, text, permission error message, command flags, and function pointers for argument parsing, topology setup, permission checks, and command execution. This header also defines the `args_t` and `action_t` aliases for use by the rest of the code.
